shipping.title: Shipping Information
shipping.subtitle: We ship electronic components across India with reliable logistics partners to ensure safe and timely delivery.
shipping.coverageDesc: We currently deliver nationwide across India
shipping.step1: We process and ship most orders within 24 working hours of order confirmation
shipping.step2: Orders placed on public holidays are processed on the next working day
shipping.step3: Dispatch timelines may vary for high-volume, bulk, or made-to-order items
shipping.step4: Order status and tracking details are shared via email once the order is shipped
shipping.delayNotice: Delivery timelines are estimated and may be affected by factors beyond our control such as weather, strikes, natural calamities, or courier delays.
shipping.addressPoint1: Customers must ensure that the shipping address, PIN code, and contact number are accurate
shipping.notRespTitle: We are not responsible for delays or non-delivery due to:
shipping.reshippingFee: Any re-shipping due to address issues will be chargeable.
shipping.splitPoint1: In some cases, orders containing multiple items may be shipped in multiple packages
shipping.splitPoint2: Customers will receive tracking details for each shipment separately
shipping.trackingPoint1: A tracking number shared via email/SMS
shipping.trackingPoint2: Updates from the courier partner until delivery
shipping.trackingAdvice: Customers are requested to track their shipment regularly and coordinate with the courier if required.
shipping.safetyDesc: All components are packed securely to prevent damage during transit. Sensitive electronic parts are handled with appropriate protective packaging.
shipping.rtoDesc: If a shipment is returned to us (RTO – Return to Origin) due to customer unavailability, incorrect address, or COD refusal:
shipping.rtoThen1: Re-shipping will be done only after additional shipping charges are paid
shipping.rtoThen2: Refunds (if applicable) will be processed after deducting actual shipping and handling costs
shipping.questionsDesc: For shipping-related questions, please contact us at:

return.title: Returns & Refund Policy
return.subtitle: We aim to provide high-quality electronic components and a transparent buying experience. Please read the return and refund policy carefully before placing an order.
return.eligibilityDesc: Returns are accepted only under the following conditions:
return.eligibility1: The product received is damaged, defective, or incorrect
return.eligibility2: The issue is reported within 48 hours of delivery
return.eligibility3: The product is unused, unsoldered, and in original condition
return.eligibility4: Original packaging, labels, and accessories are intact
return.eligibilityWarning: Products that have been used, installed, soldered, altered, or physically damaged after delivery are not eligible for return.
return.nonReturnableDesc: The following items are not eligible for return or refund:
return.nonReturnable2: Items damaged due to improper handling or installation
return.nonReturnable3: Clearance or discounted products (if mentioned at purchase)
return.step2: Share your order ID, product details, and clear images or videos of the issue
return.step3: Our team will review the request and respond within 2 business days
return.approvalNote: Returns must be approved before shipping the product back.
return.refundPoint1: Once the returned product is received and inspected, we will notify you of the approval or rejection
return.refundPoint2: If approved, refunds will be processed within 5–7 business days
return.refundPoint3: Refunds will be credited to the original payment method
return.refundShippingNote: Shipping charges (if any) are non-refundable, unless the return is due to our error.
return.replacementDesc: In cases of damaged or defective products, we may offer a replacement instead of a refund, based on availability and customer preference.
return.returnShippingPoint1: If the return is due to a wrong or defective product, return shipping will be arranged or reimbursed by us
return.returnShippingPoint2: For other approved returns, the customer may be responsible for return shipping costs
return.importantNote1: Do not send products back without confirmation
return.importantNote2: We reserve the right to reject returns that do not meet the eligibility criteria
return.importantNote3: Refund timelines may vary based on banks or payment providers
return.needHelpDesc: For questions related to returns or refunds, contact:
